records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales were $392.2 million, an increase of 12.0% from the $350.1 million in the three months ended September 30, 2024 and an increase of 7.1% from the $366.2 in three months ended June 30, 2025;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales for the three months ended September 30, 2025 increased 7% sequentially and 12% year-over-year driven by strong demand across the general computing market, including artificial intelligence related server applications as well as data center and edge computing.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the nine months ended September 30, 2024, we generated cash through the collection in accounts receivable and used cash to fund increases in inventories, particularly in finished goods, to improve our product availability in a dynamic market environment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross profit margin was 30.7%, compared to 33.7% in the three months ended September 30, 2024 and 31.5% in the three months ended June 30, 2025;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash flow provided by operations was $79.1 million.
